findings.title: The hero is flat white with nothing to anchor the eye

location.description: The whole hero area: the headline, copy, and buttons on the left and the field-map card on the right, on plain white.

findings.viewer_experience: Headline, copy, and map card float on one flat white field, so nothing groups them into a single focal zone and the first screen feels thin.

current.value: A plain white background behind the whole hero with no tonal change.

findings.target: The hero reads as one distinct zone with some depth behind its content, and the text stays easy to read.
findings.fix_direction: Give the hero area some tonal depth so it reads as a zone and not as bare page.

closed_when.check: Look at the first screen: the hero area has visible depth behind it and the text is still easy to read.
